openlmisAiAssistant.title: Ask eLMIS
openlmisAiAssistant.subtitle: Ask about stock, facilities and programmes in plain language
openlmisAiAssistant.intro: Questions are answered from live eLMIS data, using your own account's permissions.
openlmisAiAssistant.slowNotice: Answers take several minutes. You will see each step as it runs.
openlmisAiAssistant.placeholder: Ask about stock, facilities, or programmes
openlmisAiAssistant.permissionsNote: Answers only include data your eLMIS account can see.
openlmisAiAssistant.error.sessionExpired: Your eLMIS session has expired. Please sign in again, then ask the question once more.
openlmisAiAssistant.error.notPermitted: You do not have permission to view this data in eLMIS. This may be a facility or programme you are not assigned to.
openlmisAiAssistant.error.unavailable: The assistant is not reachable. It may not be running or not yet configured on this server.
openlmisAiAssistant.error.tookTooLong: That question took too long to answer. Try a simpler one, or ask again shortly.
openlmisAiAssistant.error.unknown: Something went wrong and the question did not complete. Please try again.
